findings.name: Thomas' Showboat
findings.evidence_quote: Games: No games at this location. Updated 2022-07-09. Information: 1 of two Thomas' Centres in hunstanton.
findings.note: Seaside family arcade still exists in Hunstanton area; ZIv has empty inventory. No positive evidence for or against tracked rhythm games. ZIv silence is not confirmed_none.

findings.name: Thomas's Entertainments
findings.evidence_quote: Games: No games at this location. Updated 2019-08-09. Address: 5 Beach Terrace Road Hunstanton Norfolk.
findings.note: Sister Thomas arcade on Beach Terrace; ticket/redemption type per old Yelp blurbs. No game list. unknown.

findings.name: TopGolf Watford
findings.evidence_quote: Picture titled 'SMX'. Comments: PurpleMila: 'how many songs does 5 credits get you on smx?' PennPal573: '2 songs, which is the default setting IIRC'. Games table as of 2026-06-10 lists Cruis'n Blast, Mario Kart GP DX, Halo Fireteam Raven, Grand Piano Keys, NERF Arcade, PAC-MAN Baller (SMX not in table).
findings.note: Namco-run TopGolf arcade. SMX not entered in formal games list but photo+player comments discuss SMX song pricing. Treat as likely SMX presence; re-verify if catalog gap vs removal.

findings.name: Totton Arcade
findings.evidence_quote: Games: Guitar Hero Arcade (International) Free Play. Also retro/racing/shooters; session free-play arcade. Updated 2025-08-14.
findings.note: Guitar Hero Arcade maps to slug other (not a named Bemani/PIU/SMX layer). No DDR/maimai/etc listed.

findings.name: Tower Arcade
findings.evidence_quote: Current games: Minecraft Dungeons Arcade, Jurassic Park Arcade (2015), Deal Or No Deal Pusher. Comments (StaticFish, 14-16 years ago): 'Price changed for Euromix2, DDRX has been removed for a long time.' Updated 2023-08-06.
findings.note: Historical DDR/EuroMIX removed long ago. Current ZIv list is sparse (3 cabs) so cannot treat as complete inventory; not confirmed_none.

findings.name: Trago Mills
findings.evidence_quote: Games: TMNT, Daytona Championship USA, Final Furlong 2, Manx TT, Need for Speed GT, OutRun 2, Radikal Bikers, Mario & Sonic Rio 2016. Information notes many Sega games removed. Updated 2023-06-03.
findings.note: Family fun park penny arcade + second arcade. Listed cabs are racing/fighters only; inventory dated and incomplete per author notes. No rhythm found but not positive full sweep.

findings.name: Treasure Cove Amusements
findings.evidence_quote: Formerly Harts Amusements. Games: Connect 4, Crank It!, Despicable Me Minion Whacker, Wizard Of Oz. Updated 2026-04-28.
findings.note: Fresh ZIv entry with only four redemption titles. List likely incomplete for a promenade arcade; no rhythm found, but not enough for confirmed_none.

findings.name: Treasure Island
findings.evidence_quote: Treasure Island Cleveleys Lancashire. Games: No games at this location. Updated 2018-04-05.
findings.note: Venue still open per 2026 TripAdvisor (Victoria Road West Cleveleys amusement arcade). No inventory of tracked rhythm games found. unknown.

findings.name: Treasure Island
findings.evidence_quote: Treasure Island Newport Rd Hemsby. Games: No games at this location. Website http://treasure-island.jany.io/. Updated 2024-05-19.
findings.note: Hemsby holiday arcade; empty ZIv games. Distinct from Cleveleys Treasure Island. unknown.

findings.name: Ty Mawr Holiday Park
findings.evidence_quote: Arcade accessable to non-residents... Large arcade and all the typical holiday park fayre available. Games: No games at this location. Updated 2018-07-31.
findings.note: Holiday park arcade described as typical fayre; no cab list. unknown.

findings.name: Tyne Tees Entertainments
findings.evidence_quote: Detailed games list: Mario Kart Arcade GP DX, Black Hole, Despicable Me Minion Whacker, Minion Paradise Pusher, Down The Clown, Ice Man, Pearl Fishery, Pixel Chase, Pop It & Win, Sonic Sports Basketball, Space Invaders Pusher, Stack 'N' Grab, Wild West Shootout, Space Invaders Frenzy, Simulator (VR). No music/rhythm titles. Updated 2023-07-19.
findings.note: Whitley Bay seaside arcade with thorough visitor inventory of redemption/racing/VR only. Positive inventory without rhythm games.

findings.name: UK Superbowl
findings.evidence_quote: Games: No games at this location. Comment (Littletiger, ~16 years ago): 'Machine is now gone'. Updated 2010-01-17.
findings.note: Huddersfield bowling still open (uksuperbowlhuddersfield.com; TripAdvisor 2025). Historical music machine removed long ago; no current arcade game inventory. unknown.

findings.name: Vertigo VR
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv lists Tekken 6, Storm Racer G, Storm Rider, Luigi's Mansion Arcade, Transformers Human Alliance, Sonic Dash Extreme, Hockey Table (2019). Web: Milton Keynes Citizen / Rightmove / commercial listings describe former Vertigo VR at 3 Savoy Crescent as empty unit / for let after 2023; space later marketed as Max's Burger Joint.
findings.note: VR/arcade venue at MK centre permanently closed; unit re-let. Even while open, ZIv list had no tracked rhythm games.

findings.name: Warmwell Holiday Park
findings.evidence_quote: Games: Guitar Hero Arcade (Near the bowling area) £1.00 for 3 songs; Ben Bones; Hamster's Ball; Monopoly Roll Down. Comment (luaduck, 11 years ago): 'Pretty sure the EuroMIX has been sold'. Picture of EuroMIX historical. Updated 2019-10-29.
findings.note: Parkdean holiday park. GH maps to other. Historical EuroMIX (DDR) sold. Data ~7 years old; currency unverified.

findings.name: Waterside park
findings.evidence_quote: Information: Arcade part is quite small but is open 24/7. Games: MAME Board (iCADE multi-game); Daytona USA 2: Battle on the Edge (2P). Updated 2020-02-08.
findings.note: Small holiday resort arcade with only MAME multi and Daytona listed. No rhythm. List old but venue described as tiny.

findings.name: Waves Amusements
findings.evidence_quote: Information: Not many games here. Games: Ghost Squad; Balloon Buster; Claw Machine (many EX1s); Ice Man; Skill Cut Winner. Updated 2023-05-01.
findings.note: Small Prestatyn arcade near Pontins; author states few games and lists only shooter/redemption/claw. Positive limited inventory without rhythm.

findings.name: West Midland Safari Park
findings.evidence_quote: Formerly operated by Sega, from 2020 whole arcade operated by HB Leisure. Games: Claw Machine; Monopoly; Monopoly Pusher (6P). Updated 2023-04-25.
findings.note: Safari park arcade reduced to claws/pushers under HB Leisure. No rhythm games in inventory.

findings.name: Widnes Superbowl
findings.evidence_quote: Information (as of May 2018): they have become a Sega game zone. DDR X gone...Sonic statue present instead. Games: No games at this location. Updated 2018-05-08.
findings.note: Positive note that DDR X was removed when venue became Sega game zone. Bowling still operates. No later report of new rhythm cabs; treat as confirmed_none for tracked music games with aging evidence.

findings.name: Williams's Amusements
findings.evidence_quote: Pensarn Pleasure Beach Promenade Abergele. Games: No games at this location. Updated 2015-11-15.
findings.note: Empty ZIv stub for Welsh seaside arcade. No inventory. unknown.

findings.name: Winkups (formerly Pleasureland)
findings.evidence_quote: Newly refurbished arcade, after being taken over by large caravan park. Games: No games at this location. Updated 2024-07-09.
findings.note: Towyn caravan park arcade refurbished but no cab list entered. unknown.

findings.name: Wokingham Superbowl
findings.evidence_quote: Games: Beat Saber Arcade £2.00 for 1 song (Great); Mario Kart GP DX x2; OutRun 2 SP DX; Super Bikes x2; Aliens Armageddon; Time Crisis 4; Connect 4 Hoops; Down The Clown; Grand Piano Keys; Lane Master; Space Invaders Frenzy. Updated 2020-01-03.
findings.note: Beat Saber Arcade maps to other. ZIv inventory from 2020; venue still open. insert-coin also lists Beat Saber but may mirror ZIv. Currency of cab unverified.

findings.name: Wolverhampton Hollywood Bowl
findings.evidence_quote: Information: The arcade used to have DDR Euromix 2 machine; this was eventually taken away because of the state it was in and was replaced with a biking machine. Games: Animal Kaiser; Mario Kart Arcade GP DX; Dark Escape 4D; Deadstorm Pirates Special Edition. Updated 2015-04-13.
findings.note: Positive removal of EuroMIX2. Remaining listed cabs are non-rhythm. Evidence is 2015; Hollywood Bowl fleets churn, so confidence unverified.

findings.name: Woodlands family theme park
findings.evidence_quote: Arcade upstairs in sea dragon soft play. Games: Ford Racing Full Blown, Hopping Road, Scud Race, Confidential Mission, Gunblade NY. Updated 2023-06-26 with photos of those cabs.
findings.note: Soft-play theme park cabs only racing/shooters. No rhythm.

findings.name: Worcester Bowl
findings.evidence_quote: Games table (2019-09-21): Dead Heat, Super Bikes 2, Terminator Salvation. Pictures still show EuroMIX 2 marquee and Euromix cab. Comments (~8 years ago) discuss Extreme-theme EuroMIX play and pad issues.
findings.note: Historical DDR EuroMIX well documented but not in 2019 games table; unclear if removed or uncatalogued. Do not assert has_games without current confirmation. unknown.

findings.name: Worthing Lido
findings.evidence_quote: Information: No rhythm games to speak of, but has a nice collection of arcade games, all of which are 50p a play! Games: Crazy Taxi, Sega Rally Championship, The Fast and the Furious, House of the Dead, Time Crisis II, Virtua Tennis. Updated 2023-05-23.
findings.note: Explicit positive statement of no rhythm games plus full non-rhythm cab list.

findings.name: Ye Olde King & Queen
findings.evidence_quote: Pub with a few games. Games: Street Fighter II Champion Edition; iCade 60-in-1 x2; The Simpsons pinball; Mario Kart Arcade GP DX (bootleg wheel upstairs); House of the Dead. Updated 2025-11-13.
findings.note: Recent visitor inventory of small Brighton pub arcade; fighters/emulation/racing/gun only. No rhythm.

findings.name: iFun Family Entertainment Centre
findings.evidence_quote: Information: Most machines here are redemption based, outside of a few exceptions. Games: Grand Piano Keys; Quik Drop. Updated 2025-08-11.
findings.note: Herne Bay FEC. Grand Piano Keys is novelty/redemption style, not a tracked rhythm slug. Author states mostly redemption; only two cabs logged but fits FEC profile without Bemani/PIU/SMX.

findings.name: AMC 8 at Cherry Creek
findings.evidence_quote: Games: Guitar Hero Arcade Against the back wall... Premium Songs cost 2 more tokens. Updated 2012-09-17. Theatre still listed as AMC DINE-IN Cherry Creek 8 at same address.
findings.note: Theatre open after dine-in remodel; 2012-only GH entry. Likely churned. GH would map to other if still present. Currency unverified.

findings.name: Action City
findings.evidence_quote: Information: DDR Extreme cabinet - Both pads work well, able to pass Legend Road... Games table only lists Guitar Hero Arcade (Moderate). Updated 2018-05-19. Visitor comments praise 'this machine' for AAA/DDR play (~12 years ago).
findings.note: Metropolis Resort Action City. GH on games list (other). Venue info still describes DDR Extreme but it is not in games table after 2018; do not assert ddr without fresh confirmation. Only reporting other from listed GH.

findings.name: Acton Bowladrome & Arcade
findings.evidence_quote: Games: Guitar Hero Arcade (Perfect) first in list; large pinball/redemption/racing inventory. Updated 2026-04-04.
findings.note: Candlepin + arcade in Acton MA. GH -> other. No DDR/PIU/SMX on long inventory.

findings.name: Adventure Island
findings.evidence_quote: Games: In the Groove 2 (North America) Location Arcade Comment: ITG3 Running on an Extreme cabinet. US$0.75 for 3 songs Great. Updated 2026-04-03. Multiple photos of ITG3/ITG2 cab. Comment: 'the ITG3 cab is still here'.
findings.note: In The Groove maps to other per project README. Venue website confirms open game room in Henderson NC.

findings.name: Alamo Drafthouse (Valley Fair)
findings.evidence_quote: Small arcade at entrance. Games: Guitar Hero Arcade 6 credits/play Great; Fast & Furious Arcade 2022; Monster Kart; Jurassic Park Arcade 2015. Updated 2026-03-01.
findings.note: GH -> other. Santa Clara Valley Fair Alamo lobby arcade.

findings.name: All Star Bowling & Entertainment - West Jordan
findings.evidence_quote: Games: Guitar Hero Arcade (Middle of arcade near Monopoly Roll n Go...). Plus large FEC mix of racing/redemption. Updated 2023-08-12.
findings.note: GH -> other. No SMX/DDR/PIU listed on detailed floor map style inventory.

findings.name: Altitude Trampoline Park (Delmar)
findings.evidence_quote: Beat Saber Arcade: Currently out of order as of April 10th, 2024. According to the manager, has been out of service for several months, and there are no plans on fixing the cab due to them being unable to get the broken part. Still listed on site. Updated 2024-04-11.
findings.note: Beat Saber Arcade maps to other. Cab present but Not Working with no repair plan as of 2024-04; may have been removed later.

findings.name: Angelo's Pizza
findings.evidence_quote: Used to have DDR and Guitar Hero until Hurricane Matthew. They recently got Guitar Hero again... Games: Guitar Hero Arcade US$1.00 for 1 song Perfect. Updated 2022-07-22.
findings.note: Outer Banks pizza arcade cycles machines. GH present 2022; DDR long gone post-Matthew. GH -> other. Currency unverified.

findings.name: Araiguma Advanced Battle Center
findings.evidence_quote: Primarily focused on fighting games but is offering more rhythm gaming over time. Games: Guitar Hero Arcade Comment: This is actually Clone Hero but there's not really an option for that Free Play Perfect. Plus Soulcalibur II, 3rd Strike x2, Vampire Savior. Updated 2026-02-10.
findings.note: Clone Hero / GH-style setup maps to other. Urbana IL pay-what-you-can FGC room.

findings.name: Arcadia (Gatlinburg Space Needle)
findings.evidence_quote: Update March 2026: The only rhythm game on site is a single Guitar Hero cabinet in the basement next to the pinball machines. Older: Pump It Up and Percussion Master removed (comments ~11 years). Games list still includes Guitar Hero Arcade. Updated 2026-04-11.
findings.note: GH -> other. Explicit March 2026 visitor note that GH is the only rhythm game; PIU long gone.

findings.name: Asylum Bar + Arcade
findings.evidence_quote: In the Groove 2: Down as of 03/07/2026, CRT died... told it'll be replaced with LCD but still no updates. StepMania Converted Cabinet listed as placeholder for the ITG. Was SN2 then Simply Love. Updated 2026-03-07. Also Initial D AS8, fighting games.
findings.note: AREA15 Las Vegas. ITG/StepMania convert maps to other. Cab present but Not Working as of Mar 2026 pending LCD fix.

findings.name: Asylum Mini Golf & Arcade
findings.evidence_quote: Games: Guitar Hero Arcade US$1.00 Moderate; plus pinball, Mario Kart GP, Jurassic Park Arcade, etc. Updated 2024-01-05.
findings.note: North Bend OR mini golf + arcade. GH -> other. No SMX/DDR/PIU listed.
